module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 61

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture61

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 61](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph $G$, the size $f(G)$ of a largest induced forest
satisfies $f(G) \ge \mathrm{residue}(G) + \lceil \mathrm{diam}(G) / 3 \rceil$,
where $\mathrm{residue}(G)$ is the Havel-Hakimi residue and $\mathrm{diam}(G)$
is the diameter of $G$.

See: Favaron, Mahéo, Saclé (1991) for the residue; DeLaVina's Graffiti.pc for the conjecture.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture61 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    (residue G : ℝ) + ⌈(G.diam : ℝ) / 3⌉ ≤ (G.largestInducedForestSize : ℝ) := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The `largestInducedForestSize` is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ G.largestInducedForestSize := Nat.zero_le _

/-- The residue of $K_2$ equals $1$: degree sequence is $[1, 1]$; one Havel-Hakimi
step gives $[0]$, leaving a single zero. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : residue (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) = 1 := by
  simp [residue, Fin.univ_succ, Multiset.sort_cons, residueAux, havelHakimiStep]

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture61

reformulations.difference: Lean assumes Nontrivial α, whereas the source states the bound for simple connected graphs without explicitly excluding the singleton graph.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For a finite graph on at most one vertex, residue and largestInducedForestSize both equal the number of vertices, and diam is zero. Thus the asserted inequality is equality in every omitted boundary case. Restricting the universal connected-graph claim to nontrivial vertex types therefore leaves an equivalent statement. This equivalence was proved as Audit.nontrivial_restriction_equiv in /workspace/review/scratch.lean, without using conjecture61 or sorryAx.

review.notes: The conjecture and both sanity checks faithfully state their intended mathematics. The source gives exactly f(G) ≥ res(G) + CEIL[diam(G)/3]. The Havel–Hakimi implementation, induced-forest vertex count, diameter, ceiling, and coercions agree with the source. Lean experiments verified the empty, singleton and K₂ boundary values, established that the forest supremum is nonempty, bounded and attained, and ruled out the diameter's default-value case under finite connectivity. The live university HTTPS endpoint was unavailable; status was checked against the latest accessible July 2026 archived lists, both of which mark Conjecture 61 open. No source-supported status mismatch was found.
